jobs.name: papertrack: TS nodule case index
jobs.command: python -m voxtoken.data.build_ts_nodule_case_index --ts-csv /data/tiasha/CT-RATE/dataset/ts_seg/ts_lung_nodules/valid_metadata.csv --masks-root /data/tiasha/CT-RATE/dataset/ts_seg/ts_lung_nodules/valid_fixed --out artifacts/ct_rate_ts_nodules_index && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_ts_case_index --in artifacts/ct_rate_ts_nodules_index/cases.jsonl --require-n-ge 20 --valid-splits train val test

jobs.name: papertrack: build nodule GT manifest (ts_index)
jobs.command: python -m voxtoken.data.ct_rate_ts_manifest --in artifacts/ct_rate_ts_nodules_index/cases.jsonl --in-mode ts_index --task lung_nodules --out artifacts/ct_rate_ts_nodule_gt_paper_e0912 --config voxtoken/configs/ct_rate_ts_grounding_e0907.yaml --max-cases 0 && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_ct_rate_ts_manifest --in artifacts/ct_rate_ts_nodule_gt_paper_e0912/manifest.jsonl --require-n-ge 20 --require-gt-is-pseudo --require-coord-system token_space_mm

jobs.name: papertrack: train policy + benchmark + improvement gate
jobs.command: python -m voxtoken.runner.train_policy --config voxtoken/configs/train_policy_ct_rate_ts_paper_e0914.yaml && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_policy_checkpoint --in outputs/train_policy/E0914/checkpoint.json --require-nondefault-weights && python -m voxtoken.runner.ct_rate_grounding_benchmark --manifest artifacts/ct_rate_ts_nodule_gt_paper_e0912/manifest.jsonl --out artifacts/e0914_benchmark --config voxtoken/configs/ct_rate_ts_grounding_e0907.yaml --budgets 8 16 32 --max-cases 0 --policy-ckpt outputs/train_policy/E0914/checkpoint.json && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_grounding_benchmark --in artifacts/e0914_benchmark/summary.json --require-methods fixed heuristic learned --require-improvement learned heuristic ground_mean_iou 0.0 0.2 --bootstrap-n 2000 --seed 0

jobs.name: papertrack: paper export (CI)
jobs.command: python -m voxtoken.runner.paper_export --in artifacts/e0914_benchmark/metrics.jsonl --out artifacts/paper_e0915 && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_paper_artifacts --dir artifacts/paper_e0915
